home.greeting: As-salamu alaykum wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh
home.exact_alarms_title: The adhan may not play on time
home.exact_alarms_body: To hear the full adhan exactly on time, allow "Alarms & reminders" for this app in system settings.
home.imsakiya_sub: The whole month at a glance

weekly_mission.header_ayah: وَسَارِعُوا إِلَىٰ مَغْفِرَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُ أُعِدَّتْ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
weekly_mission.feed_needy_detail: Prepare or donate five full meals to families in need this week
weekly_mission.read_juz_title: Finish a Juz of the Quran
weekly_mission.read_juz_detail: Read Juz 'Amma (the 30th part) in full this week
weekly_mission.donate_patient_title: Give to a patient or someone in need
weekly_mission.donate_patient_detail: Donate an amount that could help treat a patient at a charity hospital, or give it directly to a family in need
weekly_mission.fast_mon_thu_detail: Fast on Monday and Thursday this week, following the Sunnah
weekly_mission.check_family_detail: Call a parent or an elder in your family, ask how they're doing, and help with something they need if you can
weekly_mission.memorize_mulk_detail: Memorize Surah Al-Mulk in full this week, and keep reciting it every night
weekly_mission.donate_items_title: Give away what you don't need
weekly_mission.donate_items_detail: Gather clothes or items in good condition that you no longer use, and give them to a family in need
weekly_mission.help_neighbor_detail: Check on an elderly neighbor and offer to help them with something they need this week
weekly_mission.memorize_kursi_detail: Memorize it this week if you haven't already, and recite it after every obligatory prayer
weekly_mission.donate_blood_detail: If you're medically able, donate blood at the nearest donation center this week — it could save a life
weekly_mission.clean_place_detail: Clean a mosque, park, or street near you, and try to get friends or neighbors to join you
weekly_mission.read_companion_detail: Pick one companion of the Prophet ﷺ and read their biography this week, then share what you learned with someone
weekly_mission.thank_you_note_detail: Write a message of thanks or a du'a for someone who's made a difference in your life, and send it to them this week
weekly_mission.skip_habit_title: Give the cost of a daily habit to charity
weekly_mission.skip_habit_detail: Skip a small daily habit (a coffee, for example) for a week and give its cost to charity
weekly_mission.reconcile_detail: Reach out to someone you've had a falling out with, and take the first step toward reconciliation this week
weekly_mission.sunan_rawatib_detail: Pray the twelve rak'ahs of the regular sunnah every day this week
weekly_mission.qiyam_layl_detail: Stand for even two rak'ahs in the depth of the night on three nights this week
weekly_mission.duha_detail: Pray the two rak'ahs of Duha every day this week
weekly_mission.learn_tafsir_detail: Read the full tafsir of one short surah and reflect on its meanings this week
weekly_mission.teach_child_detail: Help a child in your family memorize a short surah or a du'a this week
weekly_mission.visit_sick_detail: Visit or call someone who is ill and pray for their recovery this week
weekly_mission.daily_sadaqah_detail: Give something in charity, however small, every single day this week
weekly_mission.sponsor_orphan_detail: Contribute to sponsoring an orphan, or offer one help, this week
weekly_mission.water_charity_detail: Give water to someone or contribute to a water charity — the best charity is giving water
weekly_mission.plant_tree_detail: Plant a tree or tend a plant; no Muslim plants a seed without it counting as charity
weekly_mission.istighfar_detail: Say astaghfirullah a hundred times every day this week
weekly_mission.salat_nabi_detail: Send blessings on the Prophet ﷺ a hundred times every day this week
weekly_mission.memorize_kahf_detail: Memorize the first ten verses of Surah Al-Kahf this week
weekly_mission.read_kahf_friday_detail: Read the whole of Surah Al-Kahf on Friday this week
weekly_mission.dua_parents_detail: Make du'a for your parents after every prayer this week
weekly_mission.visit_parents_detail: Visit or call your parents, and do something that brings them joy this week
weekly_mission.silat_rahim_detail: Reach out to three relatives you haven't checked on in a while
weekly_mission.forgive_detail: Forgive someone who wronged you and let go of your claim for Allah's sake
weekly_mission.control_anger_detail: Hold yourself back when angry this week, and don't answer harm with harm
weekly_mission.lower_gaze_detail: Guard your eyes from what is forbidden, on the street and on the screen, this week
weekly_mission.guard_tongue_detail: Avoid backbiting and gossip for the whole of this week
weekly_mission.leave_argument_detail: Walk away from every argument this week, even when you are in the right
weekly_mission.early_masjid_detail: Reach the masjid before the adhan for five prayers this week
weekly_mission.first_row_detail: Aim for the first row in congregational prayers this week
weekly_mission.adhkar_after_prayer_detail: Don't leave your place until you've finished the post-prayer adhkar each day
weekly_mission.morning_evening_azkar_detail: Complete the morning and evening azkar every day this week
weekly_mission.tahajjud_detail: Wake half an hour before Fajr to pray and supplicate on three days this week
weekly_mission.ayyam_beed_detail: Fast the 13th, 14th and 15th of the Hijri month
weekly_mission.feed_fasting_detail: Provide iftar for someone fasting — you receive their reward without lessening theirs
weekly_mission.gift_mushaf_detail: Give someone a Mus'haf or a beneficial book they'll actually use this week
weekly_mission.share_knowledge_detail: Pass on one useful religious benefit to those around you this week
weekly_mission.remove_harm_detail: Remove whatever harms passers-by from the road whenever you pass it this week
weekly_mission.spread_salam_detail: Be first with the greeting and a smile to everyone you meet this week
weekly_mission.help_student_detail: Help someone with their studies or their memorization this week
weekly_mission.pay_debt_detail: Settle a debt for someone in hardship, or grant them more time, this week
weekly_mission.dua_muslims_detail: Make du'a for your brothers and sisters in their absence every day this week
weekly_mission.no_complaint_detail: Refrain from complaining and praise Allah in every circumstance this week
weekly_mission.ramadan_boxes_detail: Put together a box of staples and get it to a family in need before the week is out.
weekly_mission.iftar_meal_detail: Have someone break their fast at your table, or send them iftar — even dates and water counts.
weekly_mission.taraweeh_full_detail: Pray taraweeh at the mosque this week and stay until the imam finishes.
weekly_mission.juz_a_day_detail: Read one juz daily to finish the Mus'haf by the end of the month — track it from the Quran tab.
weekly_mission.last_ten_qiyam_detail: Spend the last ten nights in prayer and dua, and seek Laylat al-Qadr on the odd nights.
weekly_mission.zakat_fitr_detail: Pay it for yourself and everyone in your care before the Eid prayer — not on the last day.
weekly_mission.itikaf_hour_detail: Stay in the mosque for an hour with the intention of i'tikaf — between maghrib and isha is enough to start.
weekly_mission.forgive_someone_detail: Reach out to someone you have fallen out with and settle it before the month ends.
